decisions.reason: As a newly launched supplement line close to the existing OTC portfolio, it is cheap to keep open and there is not yet enough evidence in 2019 to justify abandoning the option.
This adjacent skin-and-hair supplement had a visible launch push and fits the firm’s consumer-health expansion, so management would likely continue while demand uncertainty is still resolving.
The joint-health supplement is an incremental portfolio extension with limited downside and still-early market feedback, making retention the more option-preserving choice.
Although the mushroom-based immune supplement is more niche and uncertain, its proximity to the established supplement business and likely low continuation cost favor keeping it for now.

The early safety/regulatory problem around this generic blood-pressure product raises quality, compliance, and reputational costs, so a large German pharma firm with other portfolio options would be relatively likely to exit it.
